arms.name: eztrack_default
arms.note: ezTrack's published defaults applied verbatim. UNTRANSPLANTED: freeze_thresh is a pixel COUNT set on 320x240 video and this corpus is 640x480, 4x the pixels; min_duration is in FRAMES. Reported to show the size of the error, never adopted

arena_floor.reason: the arena sets its own cutoff on all 300 recordings: mt_cutoff spans 6.50 to 116.50 grey levels against ezTrack's published default of 10, by context A 16.09 (n=150), B 15.23 (n=150), a difference of 0.86. 0 recordings refused for too few arena pixel-pairs

grid_degeneracy.reason: 1 of 28 registered arms are DEFINED on every cell. The headline arm m2_p25_s0.5 is degenerate on 62% of cells and the least degenerate arm eztrack_default on 0%. A degenerate arm drops the QUIETEST recordings, which is selection on the outcome, so no arm here can carry a verdict. §4 defined FreezeThresh as a percentile of Motion, but at a cutoff derived from the arena floor Motion has a large atom at zero and a low percentile of it is zero

q1|eztrack_default.reason: only 19 animals yield a defined rank correlation, against the registered minimum of 20. 11 of 30 examined animals have island occupancy that never varies across their cells -- 90.7% of cells hold exactly zero island frames -- so the island is too SPARSE at cell resolution to rank-correlate against anything

Incumbents: the island on fit -0.00216 [-0.00536, +0.00123], on report -0.00811 [-0.01520, -0.00243]. trichotomy.reason: of 6,228 zero-ego-speed frames, 9.2% are DUPLICATE VIDEO FRAMES (an encoder artefact, not behaviour), 16.3% are TRACKING DROPOUTS (the animal's own pixels moved while its keypoints did not) and 74.5% are GENUINE IMMOBILITY. CONTEXT.md and CONTEXT_CONTROLS.md describe all of them as a tracking dropout, and that description is correct for 16.3% of them
